sampling_implementation: Raw model logits promoted to CPU float32, temperature, descending nucleus filter, torch.multinomial with a CPU generator seeded base_seed + slot_index. No other logit processor.
sampling_basis: Model-card single-step recommendation: temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95. Other values explicitly disable additional filters and penalties; they are protocol choices, not claimed vendor recommendations.
eos_basis: model.generation_config.eos_token_id, falling back to model.config.eos_token_id; never tokenizer.eos_token_id if model stopping IDs exist
